articles.title: Jensen_Huang
articles.extract: Jen-Hsun "Jensen" Huang is a Taiwanese and American electrical engineer and businessman. He co-founded the technology company Nvidia, one of the world's most valuable corporations, and served as its president and CEO from its founding in 1993 until his resignation in 2026. As of November 2026, Forbes estimates his net worth at over US$150 billion, making him the eleventh-wealthiest person in the world.

articles.title: Ramayana:_Part_1
articles.extract: Ramayana: Part 1 is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language epic mythological film directed by Nitesh Tiwari, who co-wrote the screenplay with Shridhar Raghavan. Produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash, the film is based on the Hindu epic Ramayana by Valmiki. It is the first instalment of a two-part film series, with Part 1 being based on the first three kāṇḍa (chapters) of Ramayana, which chronicle the life of Prince Rama from childhood up to his adventurous 14-year exile. The first part features an ensemble cast that includes Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, Sai Pallavi, Ravi Dubey, Anupam Kher, Kajal Aggarwal, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor, Adinath Kothare, Arun Govil, Indira Krishnan, and Lara Dutta.

articles.title: Colette_Kress
articles.extract: Colette Marie Kress is an American business executive. She has been the interim chief executive officer (CEO) of Nvidia since November 12, 2026, following the resignation of former Nvidia CEO and co-founder Jensen Huang amid a scandal.

articles.title: Nvidia
articles.extract: Nvidia Corporation is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The company develops graphics processing units (GPUs), systems on chips (SoCs), and application programming interfaces (APIs) for gaming, data science, high-performance computing, artificial intelligence (AI) hardware, and mobile and automotive applications. Founded in 1993 by Jensen Huang, Chris Malachowsky, and Curtis Priem, Nvidia is among the largest companies by market capitalization.
